description: Canonical ferry-terminal records. Terminals are shared across multiple operator routes (e.g. Oban is the endpoint for several CalMac routes; Penzance for Scillonian + Skybus). The islandId link joins terminals back to data/islands.json.

schema.name: string - canonical English name (typically the harbour/town name)
schema.country: Scotland | England | Wales | Northern Ireland | Ireland | Isle of Man | Jersey | Guernsey | Sark | Alderney | France
schema.islandId: FK to data/islands.json or null if mainland
